name: omniagents-design-patterns
description: Strict-typed Python 3.13+ design pattern catalogue, split into two skills: software (in-service patterns — GoF, functional/ADTs, DDD, architectural, in-process concurrency, code anti-patterns) and system (cross-service patterns — reliability, communication, distributed, data, scaling, cloud, distributed anti-patterns). ~20,700 lines across 13 references.
